name: Senior Citizens
overview: Scripture honors senior citizens by commanding respect for the elderly as a reflection of reverence for God, recognizing that wisdom and understanding are found in length of days (Leviticus 19:32; Job 12:12). The Psalms affirm God's faithfulness throughout life, assuring that the righteous are not forsaken in old age and encouraging believers to continue proclaiming God's strength to new generations even when grayheaded (Psalms 37:25; 71:18). This biblical perspective calls the church to value the experience and spiritual insight of senior believers as vital to God's ongoing work.
